text:
maria_cs: Heads-up: client Thalesys requesting a demo uplift next Tue/Thu. Wants EU + LATAM capacity and a header-based allowlist so their rotating IPs don't block the demo.
jamal_support: Got it. Do we have target QPS and exact windows?
maria_cs: They expect ~250 sustained, 350 peak. Demo windows: 2026-04-07 14:00-18:00 UTC and 2026-04-08 14:00-18:00 UTC.
ae_marketing: If this goes well it's a big renewal opportunity — AE asking ops to prioritize.
devon_eng: Technical plan: header pinning is fine. Route to eu-west-1 and sa-east-1. Recommend model pin to v2-small to keep latencies tight and pre-warm KV cache.
karen_oncall: Ops constraints: use a canary rollout (10% for 10m) and set autorevert after 48-72h. Add alerts: >1% 5xx or p50 >200ms. Page on alert.
jamal_support: Draft API payload below:

```
POST /v1/overrides
{
  "customer":"thalesys",
  "regions":["eu-west-1","sa-east-1"],
  "allowlist":{"type":"header","name":"x-thalesys-demo","value":"demo-2026"},
  "rate_override":{"qps":350,"burst":600},
  "duration":"72h",
  "autorevert":true
}
```

jamal_support: Plan: push to staging canary -> validate -> promote to prod.
devon_eng: I'll schedule a KV warmup 30m prior and pin model variant. Also add a short warmup prompt set.
deploy-bot: change-request 1768020001: applying override to staging canary (10%).
deploy-bot: change-success 1768020012: staging canary healthy after 10m. No errors.
jamal_support: Rolling to prod now; autorevert scheduled 72h out; TTL for allowlist 7d for post-demo troubleshooting.
deploy-bot: change-success 1768020030: prod override applied to eu-west-1 and sa-east-1. QA smoke passed.
maria_cs: Thanks all. AE will confirm header value and send warmup prompts. Capturing this in the renewal brief.
karen_oncall: Runbook link added: https://playbooks.internal/demo-thalesys-runbook (internal).
jamal_support: Created ticket CS-1428 with config, rollout times and contact list.
maria_cs: I'll follow up with AE and close once demo outcome is known. :thumbsup:
